notes.d4-date-named-page-file-format: pending P2 (Martin, veto item): an ordinary page named like a date (pages/25-10-2026.md) is reached only by its own spelling in Tine; the model opens it for every spelling of that day because the harness's key function (`fold`, handed to the model as `keys`) folds every date spelling to the day. Tine's rule is kept in code until P2 is ruled.
notes.o2-alias-on-non-owner-twin: pending S1/PQ-2 (OW-3): Tine counts an alias:: declared by a non-owner twin (a second file claiming the same page); the model counts the owners' declarations only. Kept as today's behaviour by the manager's ruling 2026-11-02 until Martin decides, with the S1 family, whether a non-owner duplicate contributes anything. Same pending note for the random class "[duplicate claim] alias owner: declared by a non-owner twin".
notes.o1-twin-*: O1 attribution lines ("owner of (page, key): model X, Tine Y") are the model's totalising fallback (path order) vs Tine's claimant order (SPEC 2.1); not a Tine defect. Harness follow-up: hand Tine's claimant order to the bridge as fileLe.
